info.title: OpenAsy HR
info.description: Employee records, departments and positions, the org chart, documents with expiry, leave with balances and approvals as hr.yaml sets them, joining and leaving checklists, the history of every change and the access log. Everyone signed in reads the directory; the other parts of a record go to the person, their managers and the roles the file names; admins read everything.

post.summary: Import employees from a CSV file
post.description:
Comma or semicolon separated, with a header line in English or Turkish. People are matched by work email or number and updated; departments and positions are made by name; managers are linked by work email; salary and an opening annual leave balance may be given. dryRun checks every row and changes nothing.

Needs the editor role.

get.summary: The month as Payroll reads it
get.description:
Everyone who worked a day of the month, with their dates, current pay and bank account, leave days by type and whether each is paid, and the annual balance. Parts the caller does not read are null; each person's look is logged.

Needs the viewer role.
